interpretation: The four real pipelines identify one clean same-device software contrast. Device-instance, operator and sampling changes are confounded in the second LS50 observation; scanner model, operator and output encoding are confounded in the LS9000 observation. No pipeline cell is repeated, so random scanner noise and fixed material structure cannot be separated.

claim_ceiling: Design-rank and acquisition-requirement evidence for one five-slide ColorReference target set; not scanner-noise estimation, material NPS identification, film-stock calibration, product profile, or population transfer.
